findings.description: Human-only release preface and implemented/verified header conflate historical and current evidence.
findings.resolution: Preserve 2026-07-27 design date and dated history; identify current fact scope, ADR0003 authorized AI_REVIEW and no fresh global acceptance.

findings.description: Redis asset: business-key prefix and conditional XXL executor wording are unsupported by current configuration.
findings.resolution: Record DB0 shared xss keys and current configurable executor9907; do not invent module cache keys or active depreciation jobs.

findings.description: Recommended common dependencies and old file tree describe plans rather than the current Maven/resources tree.
findings.resolution: List eight actual common dependencies, application.yml/application-lite.yml and compose.yaml; keep original milestones as history.

findings.description: Domain aggregates omit ast_inbox_event.
findings.resolution: Describe all five domain tables and independent procurement/Workflow consumer Inbox roles.

findings.description: Money contract omits decimal JSON strings and currency-separated aggregation.
findings.resolution: Explain purchaseAmount/residualValue string serialization/deserialization, 18,2 storage and per-currency overview totals.

findings.description: Asset ledger promises current supplier/user/unit batch enrichment that the current service/assembler does not perform.
findings.resolution: Record supplierNameSnapshot and user/unit IDs returned by AssetViewAssembler; distinguish selection APIs from display enrichment.

findings.description: Manual create/update/delete boundaries are incomplete.
findings.resolution: Document current owner validation, versioned metadata updates, no generic status/user/location edits and restricted manual-stock deletion.

findings.description: Procurement intake eligibility omits malformed-line rejection and exact amount/quantity checks.
findings.resolution: Validate every root/line, unique source IDs, positive quantity/prices, exact total equation and eligible integer equality before writes; valid ineligible lines are skipped.

findings.description: Realtime intake transaction omits created-event Outbox and replay intent validation.
findings.resolution: Document transactional cards/history/Inbox/new-card Outbox, tenant plus JSON-semantic intent checks and source-key readback.

findings.description: Historical backfill is described as automatic startup scanning and uses an incorrect internal path.
findings.resolution: Document controlled one-page POST and actual /api/internal/procurement candidate path, matching header/query tenants, strict cursor, caller orchestration and partial commits.

findings.description: Backfill and realtime event paths are said to share whole-event Inbox behavior.
findings.resolution: Distinguish per-candidate transactional source-key intake from realtime Inbox; both share source-unit uniqueness and new-card events.

findings.description: Allocation/accept/return commands omit versions and authoritative user/unit validation.
findings.resolution: Include version, targetUserId/targetUnitId, current-user guard, status/slot checks and permitted repair transitions.

findings.description: Transfer/disposal diagrams obscure local prepare transaction before remote Workflow calls.
findings.resolution: Show model resolution, local snapshot+occupancy commit, remote start and separate confirmation; APPROVED still occupies the asset until business completion.

findings.description: Single-level approval is described as an enforced current MVP restriction.
findings.resolution: Keep the original dated simple-approval decision in history; current published category-bound BPMN determines approval behavior.

findings.description: Workflow business404 is unconditionally equated with persisted START_FAILED.
findings.resolution: Only R.code404 attempts markFailed; local confirmation may fail and remain PENDING. HTTP404 Feign is unknown. Only persisted START_FAILED+FAILED permits local cancel.

findings.description: All out-of-order Workflow completion events are described as ignored.
findings.resolution: Distinguish retryable early completion, ignored duplicate/stale/foreign-instance events and conflicting same-event intent409.

findings.description: Atomic activity-slot example checks only active_operation_id.
findings.resolution: Record tenant/id/version/current status/deleted0 and both activity fields NULL; require one affected row.

findings.description: Transfer completion can be misunderstood as moving management ownership.
findings.resolution: Document current-user/current-unit/location update with owner columns retained, plus separate versioned completion transaction and Outbox.

findings.description: DataScope table omits SELF transfer-create special mapping.
findings.resolution: Add current_user_id for asset:transfer:create with SELF; maintain owner mapping elsewhere and no broad owner/current OR.

findings.description: Approval-view description omits local start state and temporary scope restoration.
findings.resolution: Require PENDING_APPROVAL+STARTED and full business/instance/task assignment, then temporary TENANT read with finally restore.

findings.description: API table mixes abbreviated paths and omits options endpoints.
findings.resolution: Enumerate every actual external and internal method/path from six controllers and state prefix conventions explicitly.

findings.description: Auth/SRM/Procurement integration implies unused realtime enrichment/detail clients.
findings.resolution: Describe actual Auth candidate/reference validation, SRM approved-supplier search only and Procurement candidate client only.

findings.description: Malformed incoming messages are said to reach dead letters without deployment proof.
findings.resolution: State consumer rejection/exception; actual retry/dead-letter policy depends on broker/binder configuration and is not asserted.

findings.description: Asset is said to store no PII and only user IDs.
findings.resolution: Acknowledge original Workflow username snapshot, free text, supplier/source snapshots and identifiers; explain current sanitization scope without universal privacy guarantee.

findings.description: Frontend tree lists nonexistent extracted components and promises transfer/disposal histories inside ledger detail.
findings.resolution: Describe four actual page/API files, ledger/my tabs, current detail/history display and separate operation pages.

findings.description: Overview total amount suggests summing currencies or currency conversion.
findings.resolution: Describe amountsByCurrency and distribution dimensions, currency-separated grouping and no exchange conversion.

findings.description: Generic degradation claims overstate blanket Auth failure and live SRM display calls.
findings.resolution: Describe dependency-specific fail-closed commands/options, local snapshot reads and uncertain Workflow latches.

findings.description: Test requirements and original milestones can be read as current executed acceptance.
findings.resolution: Keep requirements/history with labels; reuse only digest-matched existing Docker reports and leave real MQ/Workflow/concurrency/browser acceptance separate.

findings.description: Japanese/Korean human-facing Mermaid/text-tree labels remain English.
findings.resolution: Localize all six diagrams and current navigation labels while preserving technical states/identifiers/contracts.

findings.description: Original XSS prose incorrectly says a Redis outage itself forces baseline.
findings.resolution: All four versions now distinguish Redis failure -> Auth, authoritative result retained despite cache-write failure, and fallback only when Auth result is unavailable.

findings.description: Retained scope table uses incomplete ledger paths and permission shorthand that could be copied as one invalid permission.
findings.resolution: Use actual full ledger paths and expand slash-compressed asset permission literals into complete codes.

findings.description: Current engineering subsection headings and root application entry still suggest planned folders.
findings.resolution: Use current-entry headings and actual AssetApplication.java; polish Japanese envelope and Korean initiation terminology.
